- Primary use case: pre-production inference for internal accounting automation (monthly close reports, invoice summarization).
- Pilot: 3-week sandbox followed by a 3-month paid pilot (expected volume ~1M tokens/day peak).
- Security: SOC 2 required; customer data will remain in Sage VPC (private deployment).

Items we need to confirm (can you loop in the right ops/procurement people?):
1) Economic owner: who signs the PO (title/department)? You mentioned Finance Ops but want a specific name.
2) Procurement process: does Sage use PO or direct invoice? Any thresholds that require approval chain?
3) Vendor intake: do you require a signed vendor packet + W-9 before PO issuance?
4) Invoice routing: billing@ or payables@? Is there a specific AP contact?

Attachments: attached vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (vendor intake) and a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf) for the pilot.

Proposed next steps
- If you can confirm the economic owner and AP contact I’ll loop in Monica (on our side) to prep the vendor packet and finalize the SOW.
- We’ll start the pilot environment once vendor intake is complete and PO is issued / contract countersigned.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if helpful.

Best,

Hi Logan — great to meet you and Marissa earlier. Appreciate the clear notes. Answers inline below: 

1) Economic owner: John Patel, Director of Finance Ops (john.patel@sagefin.com). He signs POs for new vendor pilots up to $75k; anything above routes to VP Finance.
2) Procurement process: we typically require a PO for any contracted spend. For pilots under $25k some teams start with a contractor invoice, but given the pilot size you mentioned we'll need a PO. Typical internal approval runs ~7–10 business days.
3) Vendor intake: yes — W-9 and vendor packet are required before PO issuance. We use a standard intake spreadsheet (I attached) and our AP team will confirm once the vendor record is in the system.
4) Invoice routing: invoices should be sent to payables@sagefin.com. AP contact is Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@sagefin.com).

Procurement team — looping you in to confirm timelines and to share any vendor intake exceptions.
